Storage in QuestDB Enterprise

One table on a three-instance cluster, from the first row to the object store.

Partitions age through the storage policy. Each instance converts its own copy, one instance uploads for the whole cluster, and local data stays until DROP LOCAL.

A query reads what it can from the instance's own disk and the rest from the object store, and the mix shifts as data ages.

Two replicas join. Replication runs through the same object store: the primary uploads WAL segments, and each replica polls, downloads and applies them at its own pace.

The storage policy across the cluster: each instance converts its own copy, one instance uploads for everyone, and the DROP LOCAL seal travels through the WAL.
